**Existence & Type:** Yes, this model exists. It's a multimodal vision-language model created by Google DeepMind that processes text, images, and video inputs to generate text outputs.

**Key Innovation:** Rather than generating tokens sequentially, DiffusionGemma employs "discrete text diffusion," where it "iteratively denoises blocks of tokens in parallel, significantly increasing decoding speed." This enables generation speeds exceeding 1100 tokens per second in low-batch scenarios.

**Architecture:** Built on a 26B Mixture-of-Experts foundation with 8 active experts from 128 total, the model uses an encoder-decoder design optimized for inference speed. It includes 30 layers and supports context windows up to 256K tokens.
